title: Terms
body:
A general terms of service for Edmonton Home Services. It isn't a substitute for legal advice — have a lawyer review it before relying on it for compliance.

Using this site

Edmonton Home Services is a directory of home service businesses in the Edmonton area. By using this site, you agree to these terms.

Listed businesses

This directory links to third-party businesses. We review listings before they're published, but we don't own, operate, or guarantee the work of any listed business. Contact details, hours, and pricing can change without notice — always confirm directly with a business before hiring.

Submitting a business

If you submit a business for listing, you're confirming the information is accurate and that you're authorized to submit it on the business's behalf. We may edit, decline, or remove any listing at our discretion, including for inaccurate information or inactive businesses.

No warranty

This site is provided "as is." We make no guarantees about the accuracy, completeness, or availability of any listing, and we aren't liable for any dealings between you and a business you find here.

Changes

We may update these terms as the site changes. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.

Contact

Questions about these terms? Reach us at info@edmontonhomeservices.com.
